description: This source file provides functions for generating PowerPoint presentations (PPTX) using the PptxGenJS library. It includes data transformation, formatting, and assembling slides with content and images based on input data, as well as exporting the final presentation as a Blob with a generated filename.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a data URL, typically for images.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File or string into a Data URL asynchronously.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations to input values such as formatting percentages or currency.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the presentation title based on wizardData or defaults to 'presentation'.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Generates a sanitized filename from a title string, ensuring truncation and allowed characters.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific slide step from wizardData based on the data path's scope.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, flowSchema, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main function to produce a PPTX document with slides based on provided templates, data, and slide order.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, flowSchema, orderedSlides, wizardData }) {$/
